title: Trove ad impression
description: One line of browser/ads/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl (keyed by the close day): one display ad the owner was shown, with serving network, attributed advertiser, size, and MRC viewability. Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

ts.description: RFC3339 local time the ad was detected

end.description: RFC3339 local time it closed (frame removed / page unloaded); the file is keyed by this day

page_url.description: the top-frame page the ad appeared on

frame_url.description: the ad iframe's URL; empty/absent for srcdoc or about:blank frames

landing_url.description: click-through landing URL when the observer could join one

network.description: serving network: registrable domain of frame_url, else the ad-slot family ("google"), else "unknown"

advertiser.description: registrable domain of landing_url, or — with the opt-in identity lookup — the legal "Paid for by" name; empty when unattributable

advertiser_id.description: Google ad-transparency advertiser id (AR…) when the identity lookup named the advertiser

viewed_secs.description: seconds at least 50% visible in a visible tab

viewable.description: met the MRC display bar: at least 50% visible for at least one continuous second

w.description: largest observed frame width, CSS px

h.description: largest observed frame height, CSS px

source.description: collector id; defaults to "extension" when absent
